main.description: Find packages. Deleted packages are never returned. With `q` the result is ranked by match and capped rather than paged, because the index's substring search takes no cursor; without it the result is paged.

q.description: Substring of the package name. Omit to list.

pluginType.description: Only packages whose latest active release is this type.

cursor.description: Absent when `q` was given, or when the last page was reached.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry instance has no identity configured (HAPPYPROTO_DID), so it cannot read its own state. An operator problem, not a caller's.
